name: test_skill
description: Sandbox test skill — accepts any input, always passes validation. Used for DePIN bandwidth smoke tests and settlement pipeline verification.

repo_path.description: Absolute path to a local or temporary repository for the skill to operate on. If not provided by the caller, the client AI agent MUST auto-generate a reasonable temp path.

agent_hint: 本技能专门用于 DePIN 跑通链路测试。执行时强制需要一个 `repo_path` 参数。如果任务发起方没有显式指定该路径，请客户端 AI Agent 根据当前的操作系统环境，自动在本地或虚拟环境中生成一个合理的临时绝对路径（如 /tmp/mock_aims_repo 或 C:\tmp\mock_aims_repo）补齐到 params 中，严禁空手提交。
